name: Noah Peeters
headline: Data analyst who turns messy spreadsheets into clear decisions

projects.title: Monthly Sales Dashboard
projects.description: Build one dashboard the sales team can open every Monday: revenue by region, the ten best-selling products, and how this month compares with last year.
projects.note: Built it in Looker Studio on top of the order exports, with a short guide for the team. It replaced three spreadsheets that were updated by hand.
